intro.title: Messenger
intro.body: Desktop messenger: channels, DMs, attachments. Tour: toolbar, sidebar, thread, composer.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.body: Search, unread filter, notifications, Tour. Connection status icon; retry on disconnect.

new-chat.title: New chat
new-chat.body: Opens a modal to pick a friend from the list or search by username. A direct thread appears in the sidebar after you confirm.

sidebar.title: Chat list
sidebar.body: Channels and DMs; pins on top. Unread badges; context menu: mute, archive, profile.

thread.title: Message thread
thread.body: Bubbles, reactions, attachments; scroll-to-bottom control. Load earlier at top.

composer.title: Composer
composer.body: Enter sends; Shift+Enter newline per settings. Attach files; rate limit banner above field.

outro.title: Done
outro.body: Pick a chat. gaf-chat-guide narration; replay from toolbar.

videoCallGuide.kbdHint: Navigate with arrow keys, Home, End; press Escape to close.

intro.title: Video call
intro.body: Jitsi/WebRTC window: toolbar and stage. One active call per user.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.body: Room name, invite, mute/camera/hangup. Hangup releases devices.

call-stage.title: Call stage
call-stage.body: Video tiles or connecting placeholder. Banner if call is in another tab.

outro.title: Done
outro.body: Continue or hang up. video-call-guide WAV.
